fusions.name: Ram From Below
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and rams it for 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Won't Let Go
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a clinging bite deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and gives you 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Will Not Budge
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.
